entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: Message sent by network when EAP authentication procedures are unsuccessful, indicating authentication failure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESULT message
entities.description: NAS message used to transport EAP result messages including EAP-failure in certain scenarios.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message used to transport EAP-failure message when authentication fails with SUCI or when identification procedure is not initiated.

entities.name: EAP result message transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for transporting EAP result messages including EAP-failure in NAS messages.

entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to retrieve SUCI from UE after failed authentication with 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Primary authentication procedure using EAP method that can be restarted with retrieved SUCI.

entities.name: Registration procedure with emergency registration
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated by UE with 5GS registration type set to emergency registration.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI used for identification
entities.description: Condition where UE used 5G-GUTI as identity in initial NAS message.

entities.name: SUCI used for identification
entities.description: Condition where UE used SUCI as identity in initial NAS message or restarted authentication procedure.

entities.name: Emergency registration without user identity
entities.description: Condition where UE initiates emergency registration and AMF is configured to allow it without user identity.

entities.name: 5GS registration type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of registration procedure, including emergency registration.

relations.description: EAP result message transport procedure uses AUTHENTICATION RESULT message to transport EAP-failure.
EAP result message transport procedure uses AUTHENTICATION REJECT message to transport EAP-failure.
When 5G-GUTI was used and authentication fails, network initiates identification procedure to retrieve SUCI.
When SUCI was used or network decides not to initiate identification procedure, EAP-failure is transported in AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
During emergency registration without user identity, AMF may not follow standard EAP-failure transport procedures.
Registration procedure with emergency registration includes 5GS registration type IE set to emergency registration.
